title: WBCA Opens 2027 Vendor Applications for 129th Washington's Birthday Celebration
excerpt: The Washington's Birthday Celebration Association has opened vendor applications for the 2027 celebration, inviting food vendors, merchandise sellers and local businesses to apply online before the Dec. 28 deadline.
content:
The Washington's Birthday Celebration Association (WBCA) has opened applications for food vendors, merchandise vendors and local businesses to take part in the 129th Washington's Birthday Celebration in 2027. The association announced Tuesday, Nov. 17, that applications are now available online.

The deadline to apply is Dec. 28, 2026. Vendor categories include food booths, concession trailers and food trucks, merchandise and activity vendors, amusement vendors and corporate vendors.

Featured events listed on the application page include the WBCA Jalapeño Festival, Feb. 5–6, 2027, at Sames Auto Arena, and the WBCA Pipes & Stripes Car Show, Feb. 13, 2027, at El Metro Park & Ride.

Standard vendor space is 12 feet by 12 feet, and space is limited. Vendors must provide their own tables, chairs, electrical source, signage and portable water, and liability insurance of at least $1 million is required, with WBCA coverage available for $100 per event. Applications and full details are available at wbcalaredo.org.

Source: Washington's Birthday Celebration Association, Nov. 17, 2026; wbcalaredo.org vendor application page.
